'''Longwind''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in the [[Trax sector/Legends|Trax sector]] of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].

==History==
This [[Planet/Legends|planet]] was originally settled by criminals who had been released after serving their sentences in the [[Prison/Legends|prisons]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Old Republic]], some 75 [[Standard year/Legends|years]] before the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]]. The planet emerged as the textile center of the [[Trax sector/Legends|Trax sector]], and a thriving agricultural system also contributed to its economy. The [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance]] established an alternate command base on Longwind during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].
